title: OneDrive: odcli command-line tool for the sync app
summary: The briefing accurately presents odcli as a roadmap plan, with March CY2027 as a target rather than a commitment. The updated sync release notes do not document odcli, and independent searches found no documentation resolving the installation, default, permissions or control gaps the briefing identifies.
